scored_papers.title: Perturbative unitarity bounds from qubit entanglement in scalar scattering and QED
scored_papers.abstract: In the framework of $2\to 2$ relativistic scattering described by the perturbative $S$-matrix, we perform a comprehensive analysis of the properties of quantum channels obtained by tracing out the momentum from the scattered state. We work in two distinct scenarios with qubit degrees of freedom: flavored scalar contact interactions and QED, focusing in particular on initial-state leptons with transverse polarization. We identify the conditions that make the quantum channel unitary, calculate the entanglement of the qubits through the concurrence, and use its maximally allowed value to extract perturbativity upper bounds on the coupling constants. We find that the limits are often more constraining than the corresponding partial-wave expansion bounds, and that they allow us to bypass some of the obstacles associated in the latter with the singular behavior of forward scattering.
scored_papers.reason: ⚛️🔗🎯 摂動論の S 行列で運動量をトレースアウトし、qubit のもつれから摂動ユニタリ性の上限を出す！散乱でのもつれ・ユニタリ性という好みのテーマど真ん中✨
scored_papers.summary: 🧮 フレーバー付きスカラーと横偏極レプトンの QED で 2→2 散乱の量子チャネルを解析。ユニタリになる条件とコンカレンスを求め、最大もつれから結合定数を制限。部分波展開より強く前方散乱の特異性も回避。

scored_papers.title: Class-resolved sifting for quantum key distribution with photon pairs hyperentangled in polarization and transverse spatial variables
scored_papers.abstract: Photon pairs hyperentangled in polarization and transverse spatial variables can carry two key bits per pair in entanglement-based quantum key distribution. We develop class-resolved sifting for such sources: every detected pair is assigned to a class according to which degrees of freedom were measured in compatible bases, and error and key rates are estimated separately in each class. Applied to previously reported data from a two-crystal spontaneous parametric down-conversion source read out in intermediate fractional-Fourier planes, the method recovers the key yield of independent sifting and turns the comparison between classes into a quantitative consistency test for cross-dependencies between the two degrees of freedom. The measured dependence lies below the spatial-polarization coupling predicted for the source, at the edge of the present statistical sensitivity. Resolving the data by polarization-analyzer setting, we find an approximately twofold dependence of the spatial error on the polarization setting in one readout arm, attributable to the measurement apparatus rather than to the source and relevant to basis-dependent side channels. We compare the hyperentangled protocol with a single 4-dimensional system measured in two mutually unbiased bases. Fundamentally, both yield the same key per detected pair and obey the same entropic bound, but they differ in their tensor-product structure: hyperentanglement factors the bases into separate two-outcome measurements, which are simpler to implement and allow errors to be attributed to each degree of freedom, whereas a single variable gives access to non-product bases that can increase the noise tolerance. For the present source, whose polarization coherence is limited by partial which-crystal erasure, a single-variable spatial encoding would yield more key only if its four-outcome readout kept the symbol error within a few percent.
scored_papers.reason: 👯🌊🔐 偏光と横方向空間の超もつれ SPDC 光子対で鍵を2ビット取る QKD！自由度間の結合を分類ごとの誤り率で検証し、which-crystal 消去でのコヒーレンス制限も見える話✨
scored_papers.summary: 📊 2結晶 SPDC 源を分数フーリエ面で読んだ既存データに分類別ふるい分けを適用。両自由度の相互依存を定量的に検査し、偏光設定による空間誤差の約2倍の変化は測定装置由来と判定。4次元1変数符号化とも比較。
